text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first three years of the Twinkle 
Series. Rulership had achieved fairly 
decent results.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pitched as "easy for anyone to apply!", 
that strategy gained more and more 
traction with each passing day...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Chatter, chatter, buzz, buzz...*)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, our division has grown into quite 
a large family, hasn't it?
choice_data_list: Yeah, the Rulership Troupe is a huge hit.

Yeah, the Rulership fan club is a huge 
hit, huh!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... At first, there were only four 
people, but word of mouth spread like 
wildfire...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Just so you know, it's not the Rulership 
Gang, it's the Rulership Gang 
(Provisional). (Provisional), got it?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed there was still room for debate 
regarding the name.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Is it spring already...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
So much time has passed. Ever since that 
spring in Dubai...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Hm, is that—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Yo.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Long time no see.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Sorry about that. I haven't been able to 
show my face around the school lately.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Going is such a pai— No, I mean, I have 
too much to do myself.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Because there are countless Umamusume who 
wish to learn my strategies.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...How unexpected. I never pegged you for 
the caring, attentive type.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: That may be so, but—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ruler-san, could you please give this girl 
a little bit of advice?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I ended up teaching just based on 
intuition, you see. Explaining things 
theoretically is rather difficult.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ruler-senpai, Ruler-senpai, help, help!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'm a genius, so I can't really teach it. 
Hmm~ though giving love hugs is the one 
thing I'm great at♡

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
There's a girl who's struggling to 
improve... would you mind?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I really want to help her make her debut 
somehow... If it's you, I know you can do 
it.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It was a case of doing it reluctantly 
because I was asked... Even so—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I won't be holding your hand through it 
all; I'll merely be teaching you the 
fundamental concepts.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Theory over spirit. Well, I suppose that's 
modern.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: The era—it calls for me, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Whether that's what's wanted or not. 
The trend favoring theory over pure 
willpower makes sense, I suppose."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Are you still... training as thoroughly 
as ever over there?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I've been giving Duramente-san 
one-on-one lessons.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
The school focuses on a select few. That's 
how it's always been done, after all...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
It might also be because I didn't have 
anyone like that around me when I was a 
child.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I see... Well, to each their own, but...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
All we can do is see the results. After 
all, training is a game with no correct 
answer.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"...Look at the time. I've got to head 
over to my Trainer's."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It seems Kiseki is coming today as well. 
I'll have to play... er, keep her company.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
See you later then, Admire Groove. Looks 
like I had you... all wrong.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: A misunderstanding...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I thought we'd never get along. And 
yet...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps, I thought we might come to 
understand each other a little.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —Not quite.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Don't think it over so seriously! And 
don't say it so bluntly after that! Now I 
know for sure that you don't really mean 
it!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Good grief...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"If I have time again in the future, I 
might drop by the school. So..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Countin' on you. I feel safe with you 
around.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Kiseki spoke with Admire Groove 
today.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: How should I describe that guy...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
She hadn't changed a bit. Well, I suppose 
that's fine.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
They are them, and we are us. Now then, 
Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Targeting the spring GⅠs looks difficult, 
but we still wanted to somehow aim for the 
Kikuka Sho in the autumn.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Let's see the plan you came up with. 
Long-distance races are, above all, about 
strategy.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes! I've thought of something amazing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Toward ruling over every era of the 
Twinkle Series—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rulership continues to devise strategies 
today, together with her squad members.
